d:
The Official Music Video for Every Breath You Take. Taken from The Police - Synchronicity.
Order 40th anniversary editions of Synchronicity now, available as super deluxe 6CD and 4LP boxsets, coloured 2LP, deluxe 2CD and 1LP picture disc. Featuring the band's first truly comprehensive collection of unreleased material.
Lyrics:
Every breath you take and every move you make
Every bond you break, every step you take, I'll be watching you
Every single day, every word you say
Every game you play, every night you stay, I'll be watching you
Oh can't you see, you belong to me
